title: Build one-screen game client shell
goal: Replace dashboard-style tabs with a game-client screen where map, dialogue, inventory, pets, and log coexist.
source: Original client UI screenshots and system/menu.cpp patterns
acceptance: Map remains visible while dialogue/shop windows are open
NPC dialogue appears as an overlay on the same screen
Inventory/pet/log panels can be opened without navigating away
notes: Implemented first-pass client shell: map, NPC/exit list, and pet/log/data tabs share one fixed game screen; dialogue/encounter panels are overlays. Browser smoke tested NPC dialogue overlay with map still visible.

title: Remap WASD for isometric screen directions
goal: Make WASD movement feel vertical/horizontal on the 45-degree rendered map instead of diagonal/confusing.
source: system/map.cpp camMapToGamen and current map projection
acceptance: W moves visually upward on screen
A moves visually left on screen
S moves visually downward on screen
D moves visually right on screen
Warp trigger still fires after movement
notes: Implemented screen-direction mapping: W=[+1,-1], A=[-1,-1], S=[-1,+1], D=[+1,+1]. Browser smoke tested D from (50,116) to (51,117).

title: Load NPCs from ref-data and render sprites
goal: Show real NPCs from ref-data on the map using their graphic ids.
acceptance: 1000 has more than 80 parsed NPCs
2000 has more than 70 parsed NPCs
NPC graphics are included in tiles.json
Clickable hotspots remain available

title: Run NPC dialogue in map overlay
goal: Make click NPC -> default hi -> source-grounded response happen inside the game screen.
source: ref___data/npc args/templates and gmsv NPC talk flow
acceptance: Clicking NPC sends default hi
Custom user text can be sent
Dialogue lines do not dump all at once
Source script path is visible in debug mode

title: Implement shop window over map
goal: Use parsed shop NPC data to buy/sell items from the same-screen UI.
acceptance: Shop NPC opens shop window
Real item names/prices display
Buying item changes inventory and stone
Inventory capacity is enforced
notes: Implemented item shop overlay inside NPC dialog: shows real parsed goods/prices/source, disables unaffordable/full-bag purchases, mutates stone/inventory, and enforces 15 carried item slots modeled from gmsv CHAR_MAXITEMNUM.

title: Define character save schema inspired by saac
goal: Model account, character, flags, pets, inventory, and map location in a stable JSON save format.
source: stoneage server saac source and 2016_SA80/Linux-Main-app/saac data
acceptance: Schema document exists
Local save/load uses schema version
Flags can be read/written by NPC runtime
Export/import debug works
notes: Added docs/planning/SAVE_SCHEMA.md, source references, game.save.json snapshots, and Save-tab JSON import/export.

title: Create common NPC script interpreter
goal: Interpret common ref-data NPC patterns instead of hardcoding responses.
source: gmsv NPC source and ref___data/npc templates/args
acceptance: TimeMan message flow works
ItemShop flow works
Warp NPC pattern works
Unsupported commands are logged as structured debug events

title: Implement first-pass encounter and pet capture loop
goal: Restore walking encounter, simple battle, catching pets, exp, and rewards.
source: ref___data/encount.txt, pet/enemy data, gmsv battle flow
acceptance: Walking in encounter map can trigger battle
Player can attack
Player can attempt capture
Pet and player exp update after battle
notes: Implemented first-pass Worker battle action: active pet attacks the encountered enemy, enemy counterattacks by speed order, HP persists in encounter state, victory grants exp/stone and can level the player, defeat clears encounter with recovery. Frontend encounter overlay now has Attack/Capture/Release and a short battle log.

title: Use recovery items from inventory
goal: Let bought meat and recovery medicine restore player or active pet HP from the same-screen inventory.
source: ref___data/itemset6.txt item descriptions and existing shop inventory model
acceptance: Inventory displays current quantities and item descriptions
Usable recovery items expose a Use action
Using an item restores active pet or player HP and decrements quantity
Unsupported items remain visible but disabled
notes: Implemented /api/game/use-item for HP recovery and revival-style item descriptions; frontend inventory now shows Use buttons for recovery items, current pet HP, player HP in HUD, and consumes item quantities through the Worker save path.

title: Build grounded AI guide context
goal: Let AI explain current situation and suggest next steps using game state rather than invented lore.
source: Current game state, WORLD map/NPC/warp/shop data, save flags
acceptance: AI prompt includes current map, nearby NPCs, exits, quests, inventory, pets
AI response can cite relevant NPC/warp/shop facts
AI refuses or hedges when data is missing

title: Add deploy and smoke test checklist
goal: Make Cloudflare deploys repeatable after asset regeneration.
acceptance: README documents build-world/extract/deploy order
Smoke test covers 1000 map, NPC render, dialogue open, movement, cache version
Known local npm/wrangler requirement is documented

title: Define cloud runtime strategy
goal: Clarify how gmsv, saac, browser client, Cloudflare, future native clients, and AI NPCs should fit together.
acceptance: Strategy explains which parts fit Workers, Durable Objects, D1, R2/KV, Workers AI, and Containers
Strategy states that unmodified gmsv/saac TCP daemons should not be the first Worker target
Strategy defines AI NPC guardrails where deterministic services execute state changes
notes: Captured browser-first Web-native architecture, Cloudflare fit, local/hybrid fallbacks, and AI NPC action constraints.

title: Design cloud account and character persistence
goal: Move from localStorage-only saves to a SAAC-like cloud persistence model with account slots and conflict protection.
acceptance: D1 schema covers accounts, character slots, save snapshots, inventory, pets, quest flags, and timestamps
Per-account or per-character lock/session boundary is defined
Import/export JSON remains compatible with saac-pwa-v1
Migration path from localStorage save to cloud save is documented

title: Build first Durable Object map room protocol
goal: Restore the online-game feel by syncing players in the same map through WebSockets.
acceptance: Two browser sessions can join the same map room
Move events broadcast player id, map id, x, y, direction, and timestamp
Chat events broadcast to room or nearby players
Disconnect removes player presence after timeout
Room state stays separate from persistent save snapshots

title: Map old client protocol to web-native commands
goal: Create a compatibility map from original client/gmsv commands to browser API/WebSocket messages before considering native client support.
acceptance: Movement, talk, NPC window, shop, battle, login, save/load commands are listed
Each old command has a proposed web API or WebSocket equivalent
Unsupported or later-only commands are marked
Document explains whether old TCP compatibility needs VPS, Spectrum, Containers, or a custom gateway

title: Add AI NPC action guardrails
goal: Let AI NPCs talk naturally while deterministic game services validate and execute every state-changing action.
source: docs/planning/CLOUD_RUNTIME_STRATEGY.md, WORLD NPC/shop/quest data, gmsv NPC talkedfunc patterns
acceptance: AI receives grounded NPC/player/map/inventory/quest context
AI output can include action proposals but not direct state mutation
Server validates discounts, rewards, shops, warps, and quest changes against source data
Unsupported actions are refused with a source-grounded explanation
AI usage is rate-limited or cached per player/NPC

title: Remove old standalone simulator surface
goal: Drop the obsolete standalone simulator identity and endpoints from the active project so the codebase is only StoneAge Web Rebuild.
acceptance: Package and Worker names use StoneAge Web Rebuild naming
Worker no longer exposes standalone pet capture, pet level, or pet analysis endpoints
Old Go simulator app directories are removed from the active workspace
Docs state that pets are gameplay systems, not a standalone simulator product
notes: Removed legacy Go app folders and renamed active web project surfaces.

title: Record Worker-native gmsv and saac port strategy
goal: Decide how MySQL, pthread, epoll, Lua/LuaJIT, SAAC sockets, and gmsv runtime state map to Cloudflare-native services.
acceptance: Plan states original C daemons do not run directly inside plain Workers
Plan maps mysqlclient to D1/DO persistence
Plan maps pthread/epoll/mainloop to Worker/DO/WebSocket/alarm event handling
Plan defines deterministic NPC action VM before optional Lua/WASM compatibility
notes: Added Worker-native port plan after user clarified they prefer cloud/Worker hosting because expected concurrency is small.

title: Inventory gmsv and saac entry points for Worker-native port
goal: Build a concrete compatibility map from original server functions to Worker-native services before implementing more runtime behavior.
source: external/sources/gmsv/main.c, init.c, char/char_talk.c, npc/*.c, battle/*.c, include/saacproto_cli.h, external/sources/saac-source/char.c
acceptance: Account login/load/save/lock functions are listed
Movement, NPC talk, shop, warp, battle, and save command paths are listed
Each path has a target Worker/DO/D1 module
Unsupported or later-only functions are explicitly marked

title: Define Worker-native command protocol
goal: Replace old TCP process messages with browser HTTPS/WebSocket commands that preserve gmsv gameplay semantics.
acceptance: Commands include enterMap, move, talkToNpc, openShop, buyItem, startEncounter, battleAction, saveCharacter
Command payloads include account, character, map, coordinates, inventory, flags, and idempotency/session fields where needed
Protocol separates request/response commands from room broadcast events
Protocol doc states old native TCP compatibility is a later gateway track

title: Design deterministic NPC action VM
goal: Create the Worker-safe replacement for common gmsv NPC script behavior before considering Lua/WASM compatibility.
acceptance: VM supports condition checks for flags, items, pets, level, map, and time
VM supports say/window/shop/warp/heal/save/give/take/setFlag/startBattle actions
Unsupported actions produce structured debug events with source path
AI NPC replies can only propose actions that this VM validates

title: Add first playable quest loop
goal: Turn the existing task UI and NPC dialogue into one end-to-end quest that starts in the village, advances in the field, and completes for rewards.
acceptance: 萨姆吉尔的老师 starts a quest on hi
Entering an encounter map advances quest progress
Defeating or capturing a wild pet makes the quest reportable
Returning to the teacher completes the quest and grants exp/stone
notes: Implemented 2026-05-12. Quest hooks are generated by scripts/build-world.mjs and runtime progress is handled in src/worker.js.
